subject_summary: Observed patterns are mostly ordinary sequential TAB navigation. Matches include several local auxiliary footer/header link progressions (P03), several consecutive transitions across adjacent header/footer subgroups (P05), two clear cross-region continuations from header to main and main to footer plus one between adjacent main sections (P01), one browser-entry transition (P04), and one field-to-field transition near an embedded recovery link in the login form (P06). No clear evidence supports wraparound/cyclic behavior (P02), auxiliary-link jumps across workflow controls (P07), primary-control skips over intermediate local controls (P08), or backward local TAB transitions (P09) among the supplied candidates.
